job: Pick a position on a scale by dragging.
purpose: A styled native range input, so touch, arrow keys, Home/End and Page keys work. The accent fills to the thumb and a value bubble shows while dragging or when focused by keyboard. data-labels on the wrapper gives named stops with clickable ticks. Show the value in the label row so people do not guess from the thumb.
useWhen: The value is a position on a scale and a rough setting is enough: effort, volume, depth.
Named stops such as Low, Medium, High suit the choice (data-variant="steps").

avoidWhen.when: There are two to four named options with no scale.

states.name: dragging
states.how: data-dragging on the wrapper while the thumb is held

variants.useWhen: A few named stops with clickable ticks (data-labels).

parts.role: The value shown above the thumb while dragging.
Clickable stop labels under the track.
A visible value mirrored from the input.
